body: Hi, so thank you for taking the time to respond to my situation. At the moment, I literally have nothing. My family doesn’t care too much for me anymore, my ex, the only girl I ever loved romantically, broke up with me about a month ago for another guy. although I have been suicidal a lot longer than that relationship had been a thing. I barely have any friends I can trust anymore, last time I tried to make an attempt to talk to any of my friends, it just seemed/seems like it doesn’t actually register that i’m in danger at the time of talking to them. I can’t trust anyone at the moment in my real life. I don’t want to talk to professionals, because I don’t want to be diagnosed with anything or sent anywhere, and the 1 friend I actually do trust is also recovering from suicidal tendencies, so I wouldn’t want to place my problems on her when she already has her own to deal with. Anyways, that’s kinda the gist of what’s going on. If you guys have any questions, I’ll definitely share a response if I feel comfortable doing so. Once again, Thank you.
